title: No clear plan
description: Work starts without a strategy, so time and money are wasted on things that don't help your business.

title: Slow delivery
description: Vision without execution. Products that never make it past the whiteboard.

title: Design and tech don't match
description: The design looks good but is hard to build, or the product works well but looks outdated.

title: No results after launch
description: The website or app goes live, but it doesn't bring in visitors, leads or sales.

title: Bugs and slow performance
description: Broken Pages, buggy features for a new few users, but crashes or slows down when more people start using it.

title: Can't handle growth
description: The product works for a few users, but crashes or slows down when more people start using it.
